description: This file provides localization support for Arabic (Morocco) for calendar and datepicker components, including translations for months, weekdays, date formats, and relative time expressions.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Defines the Arabic (Morocco) locale for the Moment.js library, including month names, weekdays, formats, and relative time strings.

methods.name: datepickerLang
methods.description: Sets localization for the jQuery UI datepicker in Arabic (Morocco) with appropriate text and date formats.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Defines language settings for the fullCalendar library specific to Arabic (Morocco).
